title: Dance halls and small combos rather than brass bands
summary: He has no daytime job, never played brass bands before, and played dance halls and French Quarter clubs with small bands of four to six pieces.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Do you have a daytime job? No. You don't work during the day? You just play music? Mm-hmm. And what is your address? 21, 22 and a half Second Street. Okay. Can you remember anything about Marlenburg and the beach? Marlenburg? Yeah. No. Did you—you never played out there? No. No. Do you remember playing in brass bands years ago? No. You don't? No. This is my first brass band I've played in. You've always played for dances? I've always played in dance orchestra bands. What are some of the dance—the halls that you've played in? Nat Toe's in his orchestra. He's located in the Middle West part of the country, Omaha, Nebraska. Oh, yeah. And did you play in any of the halls around here? Economy Hall or Artesian Hall? I played at the Dog House, Alamo, downtown French Quarters, Bourbon Street.
Was that with George Williams or—? No, that was with a little small band. That was years ago, you know. Playing with a little small combination. Four, five, and six pieces.
